title: AgentDoc Authorization Decision
description: Replayable, source-neutral authorization decision for E2.2 and the E2.6 source ACL ceiling. The record carries the explicit evaluation time, policy version, complete scoped grant input, source ACL ceiling, visibility and action-policy inputs, winning basis, and allow/deny/insufficient_context result. Schema validation pins fail-closed structural invariants plus top-level freshness, hard-deny precedence, and structurally observable current source-ACL precedence; the Cloud evaluator owns timestamp comparison, remaining lower-gate precedence, grant applicability, scope matching, expiry evaluation, and replay semantics.

resource.description: Complete scope of the resource being authorized.

evaluation_time.description: Evaluator timestamp input. Schema validation pins the lexical RFC 3339 shape after identity freshness passes; identity_expired, identity_context_missing, and evaluation_time_invalid preserve unconstrained raw input for replay. Calendar validity and instant comparison are evaluator-owned and fail closed.

hard_deny.description: System-level deny observed ahead of the source ACL ceiling. True always forbids a top-level allow; unless identity_context_missing, identity_expired, or evaluation_time_invalid won earlier, it also forces reason hard_deny and a deny result. Conversely, reason hard_deny requires hard_deny true and a null basis. Because the hard-deny gate precedes the source ACL ceiling, reason hard_deny may win before an attempted required check and omit source_acl_ceiling.check_context.

reason.description: Evaluator outcome reason. evaluation_time_invalid is raised only after identity freshness passes; timestamp parsing itself is evaluator-owned so an invalid raw input remains recordable for replay. source_acl_stale records exactly one source_acl_ceiling.stale_cause: expired when evaluation_time exceeded expires_at, otherwise policy_superseded when the governing policy version changed.

nonEmpty.description: Single-line opaque identifier or version string.

nonEmptyText.description: Non-blank free-form text; may span lines.

sourceResource.description: Repository, project, space, or channel level within a scope. id is the bare source-local resource identifier; parent container context is carried separately by source_container_id — required on a decision resource with source_acl_ceiling.required true and on current ACL evidence beside it, optional on a decision resource with no required check and on grant scopes.

source_container_id.description: Provider-owned parent container identifier for a bare source resource id. When the provider exposes no intermediate container, this is the provider-owned tenant or account identifier for the connector.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry for a role assignment and required expiry for every direct grant, regardless of effect. The schema pins the lexical RFC 3339 shape; calendar validity and instant comparison are evaluator-owned and fail closed.

exceptional_reason.description: Required for every human direct grant, regardless of effect.

sourceAclCheckContext.description: Immutable inline context for an attempted required source ACL check. After the earlier identity, evaluation-time, and hard-deny gates pass, it is required when no current_authorization exists and carries the only retained provider-identity and policy bindings for that evidence-free attempt: external_identity_link_id must name the effective decision principal's retained provider identity link resolving that principal at evaluation_time, and acl_policy_version must name the connector policy governing the attempt. Beside definitive current_authorization it gives consumers a uniform read path for those bindings: it restates the evidence version while policy is unchanged, but whenever policy changed it records the different version governing at evaluation_time, including an expired record where stale_cause expired wins. stale_cause policy_superseded requires this context. Resource and principal bindings come from the enclosing decision rather than being duplicated here. For delegated execution, the workload or service principal uses its own linked provider identity while the delegator remains in the separate delegation chain. These bindings are evaluator-owned and fail closed.

required.description: Whether the decision resource required a source ACL check, independent of whether evaluation reached that gate. True requires connector_id, source_container_id, and resource on the decision resource and forces result to allow, deny, or insufficient_context. Retaining snapshot_id also requires that complete source scope even when required is false, so the cited snapshot remains bound to the authorized resource. Once the identity, evaluation-time, and hard-deny gates pass, check_context is required only when no current_authorization exists or when stale_cause is policy_superseded; definitive unchanged-policy evidence may stand alone. identity_context_missing, identity_expired, evaluation_time_invalid, or hard_deny may win before an attempt and omit context. A required allow or deny additionally requires current ACL evidence. False forces not_applicable and forbids check context, current ACL evidence, and stale cause; snapshot_id remains permitted as historical audit provenance because it never establishes current authorization by itself.

result.description: Provider ACL verdict when one was observed, including evidence later found stale, invalidated, or unavailable; insufficient_context means no definitive provider verdict was available, while not_applicable means no source ACL check was required. The decision reason records freshness and availability precedence.

check_context.description: Provider-identity and evaluation-time governing-policy bindings for an attempted required source ACL check. Beside definitive current evidence it restates the observed policy version only while that version still governs. Whenever policy changed it records the different governing version, including an expired record where stale_cause expired wins; stale_cause policy_superseded requires the context. Field bindings are defined by sourceAclCheckContext.

snapshot_id.description: Immutable historical ACL snapshot consulted by this decision for audit provenance. Its presence requires connector_id, source_container_id, and resource on the enclosing decision resource even when required is false, so the snapshot remains bound to the source scope being authorized. current_authorization repeats the snapshot bound to its independently stored evidence record so the evaluator can prove freshness applies to this exact consulted payload. Both snapshot_id values must match; equality is evaluator-owned and fails closed. The snapshot never establishes current authorization by itself.

current_authorization.description: Freshness-bounded evidence for a required definitive source ACL result; field bindings are defined by currentSourceAclAuthorization.

stale_cause.description: Recorded cause required exactly when reason is source_acl_stale. expired means evaluation_time exceeded current_authorization.expires_at and wins when both expiry and policy change are observed; a check_context retained on that record still names the evaluation-time governing version and differs from the evidence version when policy changed. policy_superseded means the evidence is unexpired, current_authorization.acl_policy_version governed at observed_at, and required check_context.acl_policy_version records a different policy version governing at evaluation_time. Timestamp comparison and cross-field version inequality are evaluator-owned and fail closed.

currentSourceAclAuthorization.description: Freshness-bounded current authorization input. Historical source ACL snapshots remain provenance only. workspace_id, connector_id, source_container_id, and source must match the decision resource; principal_id must match the effective decision principal; external_identity_link_id must match check_context when it is present. acl_policy_version matches check_context while policy is unchanged. Whenever policy changed, current_authorization.acl_policy_version names the version governing at observed_at and a retained check_context.acl_policy_version names the different version governing at evaluation_time, including when expiry wins as stale_cause; stale_cause policy_superseded requires that context. The retained identity link independently binds this evidence to principal_id and must resolve it continuously from observed_at through evaluation_time so evidence observed before linking or after revocation can never widen access; snapshot_id and result must match their sibling source_acl_ceiling values. An earlier identity, evaluation-time, or hard-deny outcome may retain this downstream input without check_context for replay, but it can never override that earlier outcome. Result equality is schema-enforced; the remaining equality and temporal checks are evaluator-owned and fail closed.

current_acl_id.description: Immutable identifier of this freshness-bounded current ACL authorization record.

result.description: Provider verdict bound to this evidence record. It is a source-content readability and visibility ceiling shared across AgentDoc permissions, not a claim of provider write or administrative authority; the AgentDoc grant supplies operation authority. It must match source_acl_ceiling.result; the schema enforces this equality, so an evaluator that observes the independently stored evidence disagreeing with the decision ceiling fails closed and records source_acl_unavailable rather than emitting the mismatch.

snapshot_id.description: Retained adoc.source_acl_snapshot.v0 record establishing which ACL payload was evaluated, bound to this independently stored current-evidence record. Repeating it beside source_acl_ceiling.snapshot_id lets the evaluator reject evidence issued for a different payload; both values must match, and that equality is evaluator-owned and fails closed. Currency is established by expires_at, connector_available, and absence of invalidated_at, not by the snapshot alone.

workspace_id.description: Workspace in which this ACL evidence was observed. It must match resource.workspace_id; equality is evaluator-owned and fails closed.

source_container_id.description: Provider-owned parent container for the bare source id, or the provider-owned tenant or account identifier when no intermediate container exists. It must match both resource.source_container_id and the referenced snapshot; equality is evaluator-owned and fails closed.

external_identity_link_id.description: Immutable retained identity-link record for the exact provider identity whose ACL was evaluated. It must resolve principal_id continuously from observed_at through evaluation_time; equality and temporal validity are evaluator-owned and fail closed.

acl_policy_version.description: Connector ACL policy version in force when this current evidence was observed. Evidence is stale when evaluation_time exceeds expires_at or when a different policy version governs at evaluation_time. A policy-version change invalidates even unexpired evidence, requires refresh, records stale_cause policy_superseded and reason source_acl_stale, and requires check_context.acl_policy_version to retain the different superseding version; expired wins when both triggers apply, and a check_context retained on such a record still names the version governing at evaluation_time rather than restating this one. Otherwise both acl_policy_version fields match. This value must also match acl_policy_version on the corresponding adoc.source_acl_snapshot.v0 record. Equality, inequality, and temporal checks are evaluator-owned and fail closed.

observed_at.description: Instant this ACL evidence was observed. The schema pins the lexical RFC 3339 shape only.

expires_at.description: Freshness bound derived from the connector ACL policy. Evidence is stale when evaluation_time exceeds expires_at or when the policy version governing at evaluation_time differs from current_authorization.acl_policy_version. Expiry records stale_cause expired and wins when both triggers apply; a retained check_context still names the different evaluation-time governing version when policy also changed. An unexpired policy change records stale_cause policy_superseded and requires that context. Once observed, either stale cause remains definitive when the connector later becomes unavailable, so the evaluator records source_acl_stale rather than source_acl_unavailable. JSON Schema cannot compare instants or arbitrary version strings; replay enforces the ordering and inequality fail closed.

connector_available.description: Whether the connector was available when this evidence was evaluated. False forbids authorization from widening access. Unless identity_context_missing, identity_expired, evaluation_time_invalid, or hard_deny already won, false without invalidated_at requires reason source_acl_unavailable or source_acl_stale; a known invalidation remains source_acl_invalidated. Conversely, source_acl_unavailable over an allow or deny ceiling requires false and no invalidated_at.

invalidated_at.description: Set when a revocation observation invalidated this evidence. Unless identity_context_missing, identity_expired, evaluation_time_invalid, or hard_deny already won, presence requires reason source_acl_invalidated; conversely that reason requires presence. Presence forbids a top-level allow; source_acl_ceiling.result may still preserve the provider verdict observed before invalidation. An observed invalidation remains definitive when the connector later becomes unavailable.

basis.description: Denormalized winning-grant summary emitted by the trusted evaluator for audit display. Replay resolves grant_id against grants and recomputes the decision from the complete recorded inputs.
